summary: First full e2e run of CineStream (movie/TV/anime streaming, Clerk admin). Backend: 21/22 pytest pass (1 skip). Frontend: home hero/rows/lazy rows, live counter, nav + mobile bottom-nav, browse pages (genre chips, sort tabs, load-more), title pages (movie/tv/anime), watch pages (server chips, click/next-server, dnd-kit reorder w/ localStorage persist, drop-on-player switch, reset order, prev/next ep, sub/dub), share dialog, My List (localStorage, tabs, reload persistence), Because-you-watched row, search (debounced, tabs, anime in All), no Adsterra, 390px no overflow, Clerk ticket sign-in admin/member, admin CRUD/toggle/drag/delete, sign-out all verified working.

minor.issue: Unknown AniList id returns 502 'AniList request failed' instead of 404 - AniList returns HTTP 404 for missing Media, anilist() maps every non-200 to 502 so the 404 branch is never reached.

ui_bugs.issue: Ongoing anime with episodes=null (e.g. One Piece /anime/21) fall back to 12 episodes; grid shows only 1-12 and next-episode-button disables at ep 12. Need AniList nextAiringEpisode { episode } (total = nextAiringEpisode.episode - 1) or allow free episode entry.

CSS var clash: index.css defines plain :root --primary:#e50914 (and --muted) AFTER @layer base HSL --primary, so hsl(var(--primary)) is invalid -> bg-primary transparent. Checked switches render as nearly invisible dark dots; enabled vs disabled not distinguishable. Rename brand vars (e.g. --brand) or give Switch explicit colors.

issues: URL row + Copy button overflowed the dialog by ~120px (flex row inside grid DialogContent lacked min-w-0) - FIXED by testing agent in ShareButton.jsx
Row posters start flush at x=0 while row titles are padded 46px - first poster is cut by viewport edge; consider left padding/scroll-padding on rows
Continue button text is dark on red - low contrast; set Clerk appearance colorTextOnPrimaryBackground to white
Site share button hidden at 390px (only counter + search visible); site-share not reachable on mobile header
Base changes every 15s with a fresh random 10-20, so value jumps a lot (seen 15->25->19 within a minute); consider smoothing (+/-1-2 steps)

action_items: Fix ongoing anime episode count (fetch nextAiringEpisode from AniList; use it for EpisodeGrid total and seasonMax in WatchPage)
Resolve --primary/--muted CSS var collision in index.css so shadcn components (Switch etc.) get valid colors
AdminPage toggle/remove/onDragEnd have no try/catch - API failure gives unhandled promise rejection and optimistic order stays wrong; add error toast + reload
Minor design items above (row left padding, Clerk button text contrast, mobile share entry)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py anilist(): non-200 -> 502 hides AniList 404s; also caches empty data {} for errors in data payload
server.py reorder_servers: N sequential update_one calls - use bulk_write
server.py presence dict is in-memory per process; fine for single worker only
Escape key does not close trailer dialog when focus is inside YouTube iframe (expected browser behaviour; X button works)

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows pass; 1 functional bug for ongoing anime, 1 CSS var bug)

rca of the issue: Ongoing anime: AniList Media.episodes is null for airing shows; frontend uses `data.episodes || 12`. CSS: Tailwind injects @layer base at @tailwind base (top), so the later plain :root block overrides --primary with a hex value, breaking hsl(var(--primary)) utilities.
